C-TAB-CLOSE-OWNERSHIP.Name: Keep the rendered document and edits owned by the active tab after close
C-TAB-CLOSE-OWNERSHIP.Summary: Repair the confirmed native active-tab/title versus editor-body mismatch after closing a document, using deterministic render-ownership regressions and isolated synthetic verification.
C-TAB-CLOSE-OWNERSHIP.Problem: Closing the active document can select its neighbor while the WYSIWYG surface retains the closed document. Existing simple browser close tests pass and do not cover delayed render delivery or a missing activation render.

Goals.Goal: Reject rendering events owned by a different or closed tab.
Keep active-tab changes synchronized with the rendered surface even when an activation event is missed.
Prevent stale rendered content from being attributed to the newly active tab; preserve document text, undo state and normal source/split behavior.
Verify with synthetic fixtures and keep all owner documents, screenshots, raw diagnostics and host paths in the private companion.

Constraints.Constraint: Use an isolated desktop worktree; preserve all unrelated work and frozen GRACE 3 provenance.
Use bounded identity-only diagnostics. Never commit original document names, contents, screenshots, session dumps, absolute host paths or private evidence links.
Normal static, Gitleaks and two-pass local-model hooks apply. No push, release-train admission, version bump, tag, installed-app replacement or release before owner approval.
Only implement defects demonstrated by a deterministic regression or an observed trace; do not introduce speculative parser/cache repairs.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Implementing background agent tabs, comments, special-character modes or table-copy backlog features.
Broad renderer/Muya refactoring or changing native file persistence.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Delayed events for a closed/background tab cannot replace the active document or write its text into another tab.
A missed activation render is recovered from the live selected-tab state, with duplicate ordinary rendering avoided.
Close-to-next, close-to-previous, repeated switching, unsaved edits, source/split transitions and asynchronous reload paths preserve document ownership.
Focused unit/browser checks, an isolated native synthetic check, GRACE lint/status and exact-payload privacy/safety review pass.
Prepare a reviewable local commit and owner acceptance instructions; ask for release-train admission only after the repair is verified.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: npx playwright test tests/e2e/session-restore.spec.ts tests/e2e/source-code-mode.spec.ts tests/e2e/split-view.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit-session
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Failing baseline ownership regressions, passing repaired cases, synthetic native WKWebView controlled-delay checks, a current public/private boundary scan, and exact-payload safety receipts. Raw native captures and owner documents stay private.

Approval.Scope: The owner explicitly delegated the GRACE fix, privacy verification and completion of this repair to this session, with approval reserved for subsequent release-train admission. Technical diagnosis, bounded implementation, verification and a local reviewed commit are authorized.
